game.name: Batman - The Telltale Series (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,Pt,Zh,Ru)
game.desc: The Billionaire and the Bat: enter the fractured psyche of Bruce Wayne and discover the powerful and far-reaching consequences of your choices as the Dark Knight. In this violent new story, you'll make discoveries that will rock Bruce Wayne's world and shake the stability of a corrupt Gotham City to its foundations. You'll have the sophisticated genius of Wayne and the fearsome skills of Batman at your disposal. What happens next is up to you.
